title: Kore ga Umi e no Ai ja Naika!

date-tvdb.reason: AniDB 8896 is the music video "Kore ga Umi e no Ai ja Naika!" (its one regular episode, "Music Video"). TVDB 195721 S0E9 is titled "Kore ga Umi e no Ai ja Naika!" (これが海への愛じゃなイカ！ on the TheTVDB season page), the same song. Only the date differs, TVDB writing the day and month the other way round.
